diff --git a/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh b/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh
index 4f535f0e..7bdd7cad 100755
--- a/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh
+++ b/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh
@@ -49,6 +49,23 @@
 #                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
 #   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
 #   stalls          number of phases that timed out
+#   defects_missed  grade.json `recall.missed` (the seeded defect ids the review did not
+#                   catch, e.g. ["d2","d5"]; [] when every defect was caught) on a
+#                   review-catch row; null on a build row, with no grade.json, when
+#                   `recall` is null or absent, or when `missed` is not a list of
+#                   non-empty strings (row writer 1.2, bd-yz1rd)
+#   regressions_final_green  grade.json `regressions.final_green` (boolean: the task's
+#                   own regression suite was green on the final tree); null when
+#                   `regressions` is null or absent (review-catch rows, ungraded rows)
+#                   or `final_green` is not a boolean (row writer 1.2, bd-m0hw7)
+#   Both are optional for --validate (rows written before 1.2 lack them); when present
+#   defects_missed is a list of non-empty strings or null and regressions_final_green
+#   is a boolean or null. schema_version stays 1: the fields are additive and
+#   ablation-report.py refuses any other schema_version.
+#
+# Row writer version: 1.2 (1.0 Sprint 258; 1.1 the Sprint 258 audit round 1 fields —
+# envelope_mismatch, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed; 1.2 defects_missed and
+# regressions_final_green, Sprint 262).
 #
 # Usage:
 #   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
@@ -103,7 +120,7 @@ while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
     --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
     --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
     --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
-    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,84p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
+    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,101p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
     *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
   esac
 done
@@ -145,6 +162,12 @@ if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
       // (if ($row.arm | test("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$")) | not then "arm \(.arm) does not match the arm grammar" else empty end)
       // ([("dot_claude_writes", "bash_mount_refs", "mount_changed", "envelope_mismatch") as $k

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
#
# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json (the
# harness copies taken when each gate ended; sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/ only
# when eval/ has none, for legacy runs — audit MEDIUM-A1), the transcripts' tool
# inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch MANIFEST.json
# (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
#
# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2), and so is an arm outside the grammar
# ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ that execute-agent.sh and the mount library enforce (exit 2).
#
# Derived fields:
#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) the requested model is absent
#                   from a non-empty models_used (ids compared without the Bedrock region
#                   prefix and the -vN:M suffix); another model beside the requested one (a
#                   WebFetch summariser, a built-in subagent) is telemetry, not a
#                   degradation (DEC-0545), (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl;
#                   bash_mount_refs: [{phase, excerpt}] write-shaped Bash tool_use commands
#                   naming the mount (excerpt = the first 160 characters): a redirect whose
#                   target is a mount path, or a mount path (\.claude/ | CLAUDE\.md |
#                   \.loa\.config\.yaml) plus a write-capable command at a command position
#                   (sed -i, cp, mv, rm, ln, tee, truncate, install, patch, chmod, chown,
#                   git checkout|apply|restore, yq -i, python, perl); reads (cat, ls, grep,
#                   sed -n, …) never match. A heuristic that obfuscation can evade: the
#                   authoritative after-the-fact checks are pipeline.json mount_integrity
#                   and took-effect.sh integrity_clean; mount_changed: the pipeline.json mount_integrity keys that
#                   read `changed` (claude_md, loa_config; audit LOW-A2); envelope_mismatch:
#                   the gates (review, audit) whose eval/ envelope and sandbox envelope both
#                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
#   defects_missed  grade.json `recall.missed` (the seeded defect ids the review did not
#                   catch, e.g. ["d2","d5"]; [] when every defect was caught) on a
#                   review-catch row; null on a build row, with no grade.json, when
#                   `recall` is null or absent, or when `missed` is not a list of
#                   non-empty strings (row writer 1.2, bd-yz1rd)
#   regressions_final_green  grade.json `regressions.final_green` (boolean: the task's
#                   own regression suite was green on the final tree); null when
#                   `regressions` is null or absent (review-catch rows, ungraded rows)
#                   or `final_green` is not a boolean (row writer 1.2, bd-m0hw7)
#   Both are optional for --validate (rows written before 1.2 lack them); when present
#   defects_missed is a list of non-empty strings or null and regressions_final_green
#   is a boolean or null. schema_version stays 1: the fields are additive and
#   ablation-report.py refuses any other schema_version.
#
# Row writer version: 1.2 (1.0 Sprint 258; 1.1 the Sprint 258 audit round 1 fields —
# envelope_mismatch, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed; 1.2 defects_missed and
# regressions_final_green, Sprint 262).
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
#
# Options:
#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums (the arm grammar, the
#                      four zone_violations arrays); exit 1 on the first bad row naming
#                      its line number
#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  row written / file valid
#   1  --validate found a bad row
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch, or "row build failed for <run_id>"
#      (the row program aborted on an input shape it does not handle; no row written)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
#
# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json (the
# harness copies taken when each gate ended; sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/ only
# when eval/ has none, for legacy runs — audit MEDIUM-A1), the transcripts' tool
# inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch MANIFEST.json
# (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
#
# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2), and so is an arm outside the grammar
# ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ that execute-agent.sh and the mount library enforce (exit 2).
#
# Derived fields:
#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) the requested model is absent
#                   from a non-empty models_used (ids compared without the Bedrock region
#                   prefix and the -vN:M suffix); another model beside the requested one (a
#                   WebFetch summariser, a built-in subagent) is telemetry, not a
#                   degradation (DEC-0545), (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl;
#                   bash_mount_refs: [{phase, excerpt}] write-shaped Bash tool_use commands
#                   naming the mount (excerpt = the first 160 characters): a redirect whose
#                   target is a mount path, or a mount path (\.claude/ | CLAUDE\.md |
#                   \.loa\.config\.yaml) plus a write-capable command at a command position
#                   (sed -i, cp, mv, rm, ln, tee, truncate, install, patch, chmod, chown,
#                   git checkout|apply|restore, yq -i, python, perl); reads (cat, ls, grep,
#                   sed -n, …) never match. A heuristic that obfuscation can evade: the
#                   authoritative after-the-fact checks are pipeline.json mount_integrity
#                   and took-effect.sh integrity_clean; mount_changed: the pipeline.json mount_integrity keys that
#                   read `changed` (claude_md, loa_config; audit LOW-A2); envelope_mismatch:
#                   the gates (review, audit) whose eval/ envelope and sandbox envelope both
#                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
#   defects_missed  grade.json `recall.missed` (the seeded defect ids the review did not
#                   catch, e.g. ["d2","d5"]; [] when every defect was caught) on a
#                   review-catch row; null on a build row, with no grade.json, when
#                   `recall` is null or absent, or when `missed` is not a list of
#                   non-empty strings (row writer 1.2, bd-yz1rd)
#   regressions_final_green  grade.json `regressions.final_green` (boolean: the task's
#                   own regression suite was green on the final tree); null when
#                   `regressions` is null or absent (review-catch rows, ungraded rows)
#                   or `final_green` is not a boolean (row writer 1.2, bd-m0hw7)
#   Both are optional for --validate (rows written before 1.2 lack them); when present
#   defects_missed is a list of non-empty strings or null and regressions_final_green
#   is a boolean or null. schema_version stays 1: the fields are additive and
#   ablation-report.py refuses any other schema_version.
#
# Row writer version: 1.2 (1.0 Sprint 258; 1.1 the Sprint 258 audit round 1 fields —
# envelope_mismatch, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed; 1.2 defects_missed and
# regressions_final_green, Sprint 262).
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
#
# Options:
#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,

#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)

#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums (the arm grammar, the
#                      four zone_violations arrays); exit 1 on the first bad row naming
#                      its line number
#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  row written / file valid
#   1  --validate found a bad row
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch, or "row build failed for <run_id>"

# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
fi

# Every input that scales with the run reaches jq as a file (--slurpfile), never as an
# argv string: one argument is capped at MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB on Linux), and the
# MODELINV ledger of a long run passes it. Scalars stay --arg.
WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ablation-row.XXXXXX")" || usage "cannot create a work directory"
cleanup() { find "$WORK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
echo null > "$WORK/grade.json"
if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
  jq -c '.' "$GRADE" > "$WORK/grade.json" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
fi
echo '{}' > "$WORK/manifest.json"
if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
  jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST" > "$WORK/manifest.json" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
fi
yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML" > "$WORK/task.json" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
jq -c '.' "$PIPE" > "$WORK/pipe.json" || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")"

# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
META_ARM=""
[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' "$WORK/manifest.json")"
if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
fi
ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")}}"
[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || usage "arm '$ARM' does not match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$"

# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
echo '[]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
  awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
    | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
                   | select(.row != null)]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
fi

# the dissent envelopes: eval/ (copied by the harness when the gate ended) first; the
# sandbox copy (the agent's tree) only when eval/ has none (audit MEDIUM-A1)
envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
  local f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
}
envelope review > "$WORK/env-review.json"
envelope audit > "$WORK/env-audit.json"
mismatch=()
for g in review audit; do
  e="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$g.json" sb="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$g.json"
  if [[ -f "$e" && -f "$sb" ]] && ! cmp -s "$e" "$sb"; then mismatch+=("$g"); fi
done
printf '%s\n' ${mismatch[@]+"${mismatch[@]}"} | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' > "$WORK/mismatch.json"

# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
echo '[]' > "$WORK/dot.json"
shopt -s nullglob
ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/dot.json"
fi
# Write-shaped Bash commands toward the mount (audit LOW-A2): sed -i, cp or a redirect into
# .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml leaves no Write/Edit input. Reads of the mount are
# normal skill operation and are not listed (prong 1: a redirect to a mount path; prong 2: a
# mount path plus a write-capable command token at a command position).
echo '[]' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use" and .name == "Bash")
        | (.input | objects | .command) | strings
        | select(test(">>?[[:space:]]*[^[:space:];&|]*(\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml)")
                 or (test("\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml")
                     and test("(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*|\\bthen[[:space:]]+|\\bdo[[:space:]]+)(sed[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|cp|mv|rm|ln|tee|truncate|install|patch|chmod|chown|git[[:space:]]+(checkout|apply|restore)|yq[[:space:]]+-i|python3?|perl)\\b")))
        | {phase: $ph, excerpt: .[0:160]}' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
fi

# Each --slurpfile binds an array of the file's values; [0] is the one value.
ROW="$(jq -n -c \
  --slurpfile p_f "$WORK/pipe.json" --slurpfile task_f "$WORK/task.json" --slurpfile g_f "$WORK/grade.json" \
  --slurpfile m_f "$WORK/manifest.json" --slurpfile minv_f "$WORK/minv.json" \
  --slurpfile er_f "$WORK/env-review.json" --slurpfile ea_f "$WORK/env-audit.json" --slurpfile dot_f "$WORK/dot.json" \
  --slurpfile bash_f "$WORK/bashref.json" --slurpfile mm_f "$WORK/mismatch.json" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
  # an unparseable timestamp (empty, an offset other than Z, not a string) is null, never an abort
  def ms(ts): if ts == null or ts == "" then null
              else (try (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) catch null) end;
  def obj: if type == "object" then . else {} end;
  def boolish: if type == "boolean" then . else null end;
  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
      (e.verdict_quality | obj) as $vq
      | {planned: ($vq.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
         completed: ($vq.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
         quality: ($vq.status // e.status // null),
         companion_planned: first((e.metadata | objects | .companion_voice | objects | .planned), null)} end;
  $p_f[0] as $p | $task_f[0] as $task | $g_f[0] as $g | $m_f[0] as $m | $minv_f[0] as $minv
  | $er_f[0] as $er | $ea_f[0] as $ea | $dot_f[0] as $dot | $bash_f[0] as $bashref | $mm_f[0] as $mismatch
  | ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
  | [ $ran[] as $ph
      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
      | $ph + {
          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
          # DEC-0545: a substitution (the requested model absent from a non-empty models_used)
          # degrades; an extra model beside the requested one is telemetry
          model_missing: ( ($ph.models_used // {} | objects // {}) as $mu
                           | if ($mu | length) > 0 and ($ph.model_requested | type) == "string" and $ph.model_requested != ""
                                and ([$mu | keys[] | norm_model] | any(. == ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) | not)
                             then [$mu | keys | join(", ")] else [] end )
        } ] as $phases
  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
        | .model_requested as $req
        | ( .model_missing[] | "\($l): requested \($req) absent from models_used (\(.))" ),
          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
          | voices($e) as $v
          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
    ) as $why
  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
     else $pst end) as $status
  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
  | ms($p.started) as $t0 | ms($p.finished) as $t1
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
      arm: $arm,
      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
      started: ($p.started // ""),
      finished: ($p.finished // null),
      phases: [ $phases[] | {name: (.name // .label // ""), label, session_id,
                             model_requested: (.model_requested // ""), models_used: (.models_used // {} | obj),
                             effort_requested, effort_effective,
                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
      hidden_tests: $ht,
      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
      defects_seeded: $seeded,
      defects_caught: $caught,
      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end | boolish),
      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
                                else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .review), null) | boolish end),
      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
                               else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .audit), null) | boolish end),
      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
      defects_missed: (if ($task.type // $p.task_type // "") != "review-catch" or $rc == null then null
                       else first(($rc | objects | .missed), null) as $ms
                       | if ($ms | type) == "array" and all($ms[]; type == "string" and length > 0) then $ms
                         else null end end),
      regressions_final_green: first(($g.regressions | objects | .final_green | boolish), null),
      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
      wall_clock_ms: (if $t0 != null and $t1 != null then ($t1 - $t0)
                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
      attempts: $attempts,
      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
      status: $status,
      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot, bash_mount_refs: $bashref,
                        mount_changed: [($p.mount_integrity | obj) | to_entries[] | select(.value == "changed") | .key],
                        envelope_mismatch: $mismatch}
    }')" || usage "row build failed for $RUN_ID"

if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
  fi
else
  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
fi

tool_use_result.stdout:

# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
fi

# Every input that scales with the run reaches jq as a file (--slurpfile), never as an
# argv string: one argument is capped at MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB on Linux), and the
# MODELINV ledger of a long run passes it. Scalars stay --arg.
WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ablation-row.XXXXXX")" || usage "cannot create a work directory"
cleanup() { find "$WORK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
echo null > "$WORK/grade.json"
if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
  jq -c '.' "$GRADE" > "$WORK/grade.json" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
fi
echo '{}' > "$WORK/manifest.json"
if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
  jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST" > "$WORK/manifest.json" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
fi
yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML" > "$WORK/task.json" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
jq -c '.' "$PIPE" > "$WORK/pipe.json" || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")"

# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
META_ARM=""
[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' "$WORK/manifest.json")"
if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
fi
ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")}}"
[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || usage "arm '$ARM' does not match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$"

# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
echo '[]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
  awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
    | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
                   | select(.row != null)]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
fi

# the dissent envelopes: eval/ (copied by the harness when the gate ended) first; the
# sandbox copy (the agent's tree) only when eval/ has none (audit MEDIUM-A1)
envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
  local f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
}
envelope review > "$WORK/env-review.json"
envelope audit > "$WORK/env-audit.json"
mismatch=()
for g in review audit; do
  e="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$g.json" sb="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$g.json"
  if [[ -f "$e" && -f "$sb" ]] && ! cmp -s "$e" "$sb"; then mismatch+=("$g"); fi
done
printf '%s\n' ${mismatch[@]+"${mismatch[@]}"} | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' > "$WORK/mismatch.json"

# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
echo '[]' > "$WORK/dot.json"
shopt -s nullglob
ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/dot.json"
fi
# Write-shaped Bash commands toward the mount (audit LOW-A2): sed -i, cp or a redirect into
# .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml leaves no Write/Edit input. Reads of the mount are
# normal skill operation and are not listed (prong 1: a redirect to a mount path; prong 2: a
# mount path plus a write-capable command token at a command position).
echo '[]' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use" and .name == "Bash")
        | (.input | objects | .command) | strings
        | select(test(">>?[[:space:]]*[^[:space:];&|]*(\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml)")
                 or (test("\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml")
                     and test("(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*|\\bthen[[:space:]]+|\\bdo[[:space:]]+)(sed[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|cp|mv|rm|ln|tee|truncate|install|patch|chmod|chown|git[[:space:]]+(checkout|apply|restore)|yq[[:space:]]+-i|python3?|perl)\\b")))
        | {phase: $ph, excerpt: .[0:160]}' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
fi

# Each --slurpfile binds an array of the file's values; [0] is the one value.
ROW="$(jq -n -c \
  --slurpfile p_f "$WORK/pipe.json" --slurpfile task_f "$WORK/task.json" --slurpfile g_f "$WORK/grade.json" \
  --slurpfile m_f "$WORK/manifest.json" --slurpfile minv_f "$WORK/minv.json" \
  --slurpfile er_f "$WORK/env-review.json" --slurpfile ea_f "$WORK/env-audit.json" --slurpfile dot_f "$WORK/dot.json" \
  --slurpfile bash_f "$WORK/bashref.json" --slurpfile mm_f "$WORK/mismatch.json" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
  # an unparseable timestamp (empty, an offset other than Z, not a string) is null, never an abort
  def ms(ts): if ts == null or ts == "" then null
              else (try (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) catch null) end;
  def obj: if type == "object" then . else {} end;
  def boolish: if type == "boolean" then . else null end;
  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
      (e.verdict_quality | obj) as $vq
      | {planned: ($vq.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
         completed: ($vq.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
         quality: ($vq.status // e.status // null),
         companion_planned: first((e.metadata | objects | .companion_voice | objects | .planned), null)} end;
  $p_f[0] as $p | $task_f[0] as $task | $g_f[0] as $g | $m_f[0] as $m | $minv_f[0] as $minv
  | $er_f[0] as $er | $ea_f[0] as $ea | $dot_f[0] as $dot | $bash_f[0] as $bashref | $mm_f[0] as $mismatch
  | ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
  | [ $ran[] as $ph
      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
      | $ph + {
          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/ablation-report.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.8 (AC-3.10; PRD AC-8.1–8.3;
# SDD §5.12; DEC-0393, DEC-0399, DEC-0400, DEC-0416, DEC-0417, DEC-0434, DEC-0435)
#
# ablation-report.py on planted rows: fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py writes four
# scenarios (main, boundary, exclusions, partial; the header there lists every planted
# number) into the file tmpdir; setup_file builds the full reports once against the
# real suite file evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml. AR-23 … AR-30 (Sprint 262): the suite_version
# partition, the not-testable / not-yet-decidable states (bd-wqbz3), the degradation guard on
# the H1 and A4 lines, and the degenerate single-task rate-fallback pair. AR-31 … AR-35 (Sprint 262
# R3, presentation only): the sensitivity H1/A4 lines, the batch record, precision and cost per true
# defect, the budget-matched baseline.
# =============================================================================

setup_file() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  export REPO_ROOT
  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
  mkdir -p "$FX"
  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
  for s in main boundary exclusions versions degraded degraded-a4 degenerate-1 degenerate-2 degenerate-ids present; do
    python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
  done
}

setup() {
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

dec() {  # dec <scenario> <arm> <jq path under the decision>
gen-fixtures.py

+def read_text(p, state, why, v):
+    base = f"{p['metric']} {interval(p)} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
+    if state == "not_testable":
+        return f"{p['metric']}: not testable on suite_version {v} — no admissible task"
+    if state == "inconclusive_by_degradation":
+        return f"{p['metric']} inconclusive by degradation ({why}); remaining pairs {interval(p)} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
+    if state == "degenerate":
+        return base + " — read as no valid pair"
+    return base
+
+
+H1_DECIDED = ("established", "not_established", "inconclusive_by_degradation")
+A4_DECIDED = ("holds", "fails", "inconclusive_by_degradation")
+
+
+def h1a4(main, v, seed):
+    """The H1 and A4 reads of one Analysis (the main one, or the sensitivity one with cap failures
+    excluded and degraded rows included, Sprint 262 R3)."""
+    h1_comps = [main.compare(CONTROL, BARE, m, seed) for m in main.primaries(CONTROL)]
+    h1_reads = [assess(main, CONTROL, BARE, p) for p in h1_comps]
+    states = [s for s, _ in h1_reads]
+    if any(s == "tested" and r9(p["lo"]) > 0 for p, (s, _) in zip(h1_comps, h1_reads)):
+        h1_state, h1_line = "established", "H1: established"
+    elif "tested" in states:
+        h1_state, h1_line = "not_established", "H1: not established — halt before promotion"
+    else:
+        live = [s for s in states if s != "not_testable"]
+        if live and all(s == "inconclusive_by_degradation" for s in live):
+            h1_state, h1_line = "inconclusive_by_degradation", "H1: inconclusive by degradation — not established"
+        else:
+            h1_state, h1_line = "not_yet_decidable", "H1: not yet decidable (no pair)"
+
+    a4, a4_read = None, (None, None)
+    if SENSITIVITY_ARM in main.arms:
+        a4 = main.compare(SENSITIVITY_ARM, CONTROL, PASS, seed)
+        a4_read = assess(main, SENSITIVITY_ARM, CONTROL, a4)
+        s, why = a4_read
+        if s == "not_testable":
+            a4_state, a4_line = "not_testable", f"A4 sensitivity: not testable on suite_version {v} — no admissible build task"
+        elif s == "inconclusive_by_degradation":
+            a4_state, a4_line = s, f"A4 sensitivity: inconclusive by degradation ({why}) — not decided"
+        elif s in ("no_pair", "degenerate"):
+            a4_state, a4_line = "not_yet_decidable", "A4 sensitivity: not yet decidable (no pair)"
+        elif r9(a4["hi"]) < 0:
+            a4_state, a4_line = "holds", "A4 sensitivity: holds"
+        else:
+            a4_state, a4_line = "fails", "A4 sensitivity: fails — harden tasks before acting on other arms"
+    else:
+        a4_state, a4_line = "no_arm", "A4 sensitivity: fails — harden tasks before acting on other arms"
+    return {"version": v, "h1_comps": h1_comps, "h1_reads": h1_reads, "h1_state": h1_state, "h1_line": h1_line,
+            "h1_ok": h1_state == "established", "a4": a4, "a4_read": a4_read, "a4_state": a4_state,
+            "a4_line": a4_line, "a4_ok": a4_state == "holds"}
+

+def budget_matched(an, v):
+    """The budget-matched baseline (Sprint 262 R3, informational, decides nothing): per review-catch task,
+    the union of a0_bare's valid trials' caught defects against a1_full's mean per-trial catch rate."""
+    out = {"suite_version": v, "available": False, "tasks": [], "a0_union_mean": None, "a1_mean": None,
+           "diff_mean": None, "note": None, "label": BUDGET_LABEL}
+
+    def valid(arm, task):
+        return [c["valid"] for _, c in sorted(an.cells.get((arm, task), {}).items()) if c["valid"] is not None]
+
+    tasks = sorted({t for (a, t) in an.cells if a in (BARE, CONTROL) and an.task_type.get(t) == REVIEW})
+    have = {a: any(valid(a, t) for t in tasks) for a in (BARE, CONTROL)}
+    if not (have[BARE] and have[CONTROL]):
+        missing = " and ".join(a for a in (BARE, CONTROL) if not have[a])
+        out["note"] = f"not available on suite_version {v} — no valid {missing} review-catch rows"
+        return out
+    out["available"] = True
+    for t in tasks:
+        a0, a1 = valid(BARE, t), valid(CONTROL, t)
+        e = {"task_id": t, "a0_trials": len(a0), "a1_trials": len(a1), "a0_union": None, "a0_cost_sum": None,
+             "a1_mean": None, "a1_cost_mean": None, "diff": None, "method": None, "reason": None}
+        if a0:
+            vecs = [an.defect_vector(r) for r in a0]
+            if all(vv is not None and how in ("ids", "cap") for vv, how in vecs):
+                e["a0_union"] = mean([max(vv[k] for vv, _ in vecs) for k in range(len(vecs[0][0]))])
+                e["method"] = "defect union"
+            else:
+                e["a0_union"] = max(an.catch_task_score(r) for r in a0)
+                e["method"] = "rate fallback"
+            e["a0_cost_sum"] = sum(float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in a0)
+        if a1:
+            e["a1_mean"] = mean([an.catch_task_score(r) for r in a1])
+            e["a1_cost_mean"] = mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in a1])
+        if a0 and a1:
+            e["diff"] = e["a1_mean"] - e["a0_union"]
+        else:
+            e["reason"] = "; ".join(f"no valid {a} trial" for a, rs in ((BARE, a0), (CONTROL, a1)) if not rs)
+        out["tasks"].append(e)
+    both = [e for e in out["tasks"] if e["diff"] is not None]
+    if not both:
+        out["available"] = False
+        out["note"] = f"not available on suite_version {v} — no review-catch task has valid trials in both arms"
+        return out
+    out["a0_union_mean"] = mean([e["a0_union"] for e in both])
+    out["a1_mean"] = mean([e["a1_mean"] for e in both])
+    out["diff_mean"] = out["a1_mean"] - out["a0_union_mean"]
+    k = sorted({e["a0_trials"] for e in both})
+    kk = str(k[0]) if len(k) == 1 else "the"
+    x = mean([e["a0_cost_sum"] for e in both])
+    y = mean([e["a1_cost_mean"] for e in both])
+    out["a0_cost_sum_mean"], out["a1_cost_mean"] = x, y
+    out["note"] = (f"{kk} a0_bare trials cost USD {x:.2f} vs one a1_full trial USD {y:.2f} "
+                   f"(task means over {len(both)} task{'' if len(both) == 1 else 's'})")
+    return out
+

+def batch_record(mans, rows):
+    """Each batch's STATUS.json (beside its MANIFEST.json, read-only) and the grader versions of its rows'
+    run directories (Sprint 262 R3); a missing file or directory is reported, never fatal."""
+    out = []
+    for b, m in sorted(mans.items()):
+        d = os.path.dirname(m["_path"])
+        brows = [r for r in rows if r["batch"] == b]
+        vks = sorted({k for k in (version_key(r.get("suite_version")) for r in brows) if k is not None},
+                     key=version_order)
+        sv = version_key(m.get("suite_version")) or (", ".join(vks) if vks else "n/a")
+        e = {"batch": b, "suite_version": sv, "smoke": m.get("smoke") is True, "status_file": None,
+             "status_note": None, "state": None, "trials_planned": None, "trials_rowed": len(brows),
+             "spend": None, "extra_models": {}, "rerowed": 0, "rerowed_tally": {}, "rerun": 0,
+             "rerun_tally": {}, "drift_cleared": 0, "outage_history": 0, "cuts": [], "paused_arms": [],
+             "grader_versions": {}, "run_dirs_missing": 0}
+        sp = os.path.join(d, "STATUS.json")
+        st = None
+        if os.path.islink(sp):
+            e["status_note"] = "STATUS.json is a symlink (not read)"
+        elif not os.path.isfile(sp):
+            e["status_note"] = "no STATUS.json"
+        else:
+            try:
+                with open(sp, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                    st = json.load(fh)
+            except (OSError, ValueError):
+                st = None
+            if not isinstance(st, dict):
+                st, e["status_note"] = None, "STATUS.json unreadable"
+        if st is not None:
+            e["status_file"] = sp
+
+            def lst(k):
+                x = st.get(k)
+                return x if isinstance(x, list) else []
+
+            def tally(k):
+                t = {}
+                for x in lst(k):
+                    if isinstance(x, dict):
+                        key = f"{x.get('from', '?')}→{x.get('to', '?')}"
+                        t[key] = t.get(key, 0) + 1
+                return dict(sorted(t.items()))
+
+            sd = st.get("spend") if isinstance(st.get("spend"), dict) else {}
+            e.update(state=st.get("state"), trials_planned=st.get("trials_planned"),
+                     spend={k: sd.get(k) for k in ("rows_usd", "ledger_usd", "spent_usd", "max_usd")},
+                     rerowed=len(lst("rerowed")), rerowed_tally=tally("rerowed"),
+                     rerun=len(lst("rerun")), rerun_tally=tally("rerun"),
+                     drift_cleared=len(lst("drift_cleared")), outage_history=len(lst("outage_history")),
+                     cuts=[{k: c.get(k) for k in ("reason", "at_trial", "spent", "max") if k in c}
+                           for c in lst("cuts") if isinstance(c, dict)])
+            em = st.get("extra_models")
+            if isinstance(em, dict):
+                e["extra_models"] = {str(k): {"runs": (x or {}).get("runs"), "output_tokens": (x or {}).get("output_tokens")}
+                                     for k, x in sorted(em.items()) if isinstance(x, dict) or x is None}
+            pa = st.get("paused_arms")
+            e["paused_arms"] = sorted(str(x) for x in (pa if isinstance(pa, (dict, list)) else []))
+        # grader versions: <batch dir>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/grade.json
+        listing = {}
+        gv = {}
+        for r in brows:
+            ad = os.path.join(d, r["arm"])
+            if ad not in listing:
+                try:
+                    listing[ad] = sorted(x for x in os.listdir(ad) if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(ad, x))
+                                         and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(ad, x))) \
+                        if os.path.isdir(ad) and not os.path.islink(ad) else []
+                except OSError:
+                    listing[ad] = []
+            dirs = []
+            for x in listing[ad]:
+                mm = GRADE_DIR.fullmatch(x)
+                if mm and mm.group(1) == r["task_id"] and int(mm.group(2)) == r["trial"]:
+                    dirs.append(x)
+            if not dirs:
+                e["run_dirs_missing"] += 1
+            for x in dirs:
+                gp = os.path.join(ad, x, "grade.json")
+                ver = "n/a"
+                if os.path.isfile(gp) and not os.path.islink(gp):
+                    try:
+                        with open(gp, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                            g = json.load(fh)
+                        if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("grader_version") not in (None, ""):
+                            ver = str(g["grader_version"])
+                    except (OSError, ValueError):
+                        pass
+                gv[ver] = gv.get(ver, 0) + 1
+        e["grader_versions"] = dict(sorted(gv.items(), key=lambda kv: (
+            kv[0] == "n/a", [int(p) if p.isdigit() else p for p in re.split(r"[.]", kv[0])])))
+        out.append(e)
+    return out

+def analyse(suite, vrows, mans, args, cuts, components, v):
+    """Every figure of one suite_version (the rows of no other version enter)."""
+    seed = args.seed
+    main = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False)
+    sens = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True)
+    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
+    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]
+
+    H = h1a4(main, v, seed)
+    h1_state, a4_state = H["h1_state"], H["a4_state"]
+    sens_h = h1a4(Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, include_degraded=True), v, seed)
+    decidable = any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or h1_state in H1_DECIDED or a4_state in A4_DECIDED
+    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
+            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
+    batches = sorted({r["batch"] for r in vrows})
+    shas = sorted({str(mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for b in batches
+                   if b in mans and mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")}
+                  | {str(r.get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for r in vrows if r.get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")})
+    return dict(H, rows=vrows, main=main, sens=sens, decisions=decisions, sens_rows=sens_rows,
+                decidable=decidable, caps=caps, batches=batches, shas=shas, sens_h=sens_h,
+                budget=budget_matched(main, v))

+def version_key(v):
+    """The partition key of a row's suite_version: 1, 1.0 and "1" are one version; None = absent."""
+    if v is None or isinstance(v, bool):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(v, int):
+        return str(v)
+    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
+        return str(int(v))
+    if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
+        s = v.strip()
+        return str(int(s)) if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", s) else s
+    return None
+
+
+def version_order(k):
+    return (0, int(k), "") if k.isdigit() else (1, 0, k)
+
+
+def partition(rows, wanted):
+    """Rows by suite_version, never pooled; returns ({key: rows}, primary key)."""
+    keys = sorted({k for k in (version_key(r.get("suite_version")) for r in rows) if k is not None}, key=version_order)
+    missing = [r for r in rows if version_key(r.get("suite_version")) is None]
+    if len(keys) > 1 and missing:
+        r = missing[0]
+        raise Fail(f"{r['_where']}: row {r['run_id']} has no suite_version while the rows hold suite_version "
+                   f"{', '.join(keys)}; rows of different suite versions are never pooled, so every row must "
+                   f"name its suite_version")
+    if len(keys) <= 1:
+        groups = {(keys[0] if keys else "n/a"): list(rows)}
+    else:
+        groups = {k: [r for r in rows if version_key(r.get("suite_version")) == k] for k in keys}
+    if wanted is not None:
+        w = version_key(wanted)
+        if w not in groups:
+            raise Fail(f"--suite-version {wanted}: no row has that suite_version (present: {', '.join(groups)})")
+        return groups, w
+    return groups, max(groups, key=version_order)
+
+
+def assess(an, arm, ctrl, p):
+    """How H1/A4 reads one comparison: not_testable | inconclusive_by_degradation | degenerate | no_pair | tested."""
+    types = (REVIEW,) if p["metric"] == CATCH else BUILD_TYPES
+    if not p["pairs"] and not p["unpaired"]:
+        return "not_testable", None
+    over = []
+    for a in (arm, ctrl):
+        s, _, _ = an.excluded_share(a, types)
+        if s is not None and r9(s) > an.guard:
+            over.append(f"{a} excluded share {s:.3f} > {an.guard:g}")
+    if over:
+        return "inconclusive_by_degradation", "; ".join(over)
+    if p.get("degenerate"):
+        return "degenerate", p["degenerate_reason"]
+    if p["n"] == 0:
+        return "no_pair", None
+    return "tested", None
+
+
+def read_text(p, state, why, v):
+    base = f"{p['metric']} {interval(p)} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
+    if state == "not_testable":
+        return f"{p['metric']}: not testable on suite_version {v} — no admissible task"
+    if state == "inconclusive_by_degradation":
+        return f"{p['metric']} inconclusive by degradation ({why}); remaining pairs {interval(p)} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
+    if state == "degenerate":
+        return base + " — read as no valid pair"
+    return base
+
+
+H1_DECIDED = ("established", "not_established", "inconclusive_by_degradation")
+A4_DECIDED = ("holds", "fails", "inconclusive_by_degradation")
+
+
+def h1a4(main, v, seed):
+    """The H1 and A4 reads of one Analysis (the main one, or the sensitivity one with cap failures
+    excluded and degraded rows included, Sprint 262 R3)."""
+    h1_comps = [main.compare(CONTROL, BARE, m, seed) for m in main.primaries(CONTROL)]
+    h1_reads = [assess(main, CONTROL, BARE, p) for p in h1_comps]
+    states = [s for s, _ in h1_reads]
+    if any(s == "tested" and r9(p["lo"]) > 0 for p, (s, _) in zip(h1_comps, h1_reads)):
+        h1_state, h1_line = "established", "H1: established"
+    elif "tested" in states:
+        h1_state, h1_line = "not_established", "H1: not established — halt before promotion"
+    else:
+        live = [s for s in states if s != "not_testable"]
+        if live and all(s == "inconclusive_by_degradation" for s in live):
+            h1_state, h1_line = "inconclusive_by_degradation", "H1: inconclusive by degradation — not established"
+        else:
+            h1_state, h1_line = "not_yet_decidable", "H1: not yet decidable (no pair)"
+
+    a4, a4_read = None, (None, None)
+    if SENSITIVITY_ARM in main.arms:
+        a4 = main.compare(SENSITIVITY_ARM, CONTROL, PASS, seed)
+        a4_read = assess(main, SENSITIVITY_ARM, CONTROL, a4)
+        s, why = a4_read
+        if s == "not_testable":
+            a4_state, a4_line = "not_testable", f"A4 sensitivity: not testable on suite_version {v} — no admissible build task"
+        elif s == "inconclusive_by_degradation":
+            a4_state, a4_line = s, f"A4 sensitivity: inconclusive by degradation ({why}) — not decided"
+        elif s in ("no_pair", "degenerate"):
+            a4_state, a4_line = "not_yet_decidable", "A4 sensitivity: not yet decidable (no pair)"
+        elif r9(a4["hi"]) < 0:
+            a4_state, a4_line = "holds", "A4 sensitivity: holds"
+        else:
+            a4_state, a4_line = "fails", "A4 sensitivity: fails — harden tasks before acting on other arms"
+    else:
+        a4_state, a4_line = "no_arm", "A4 sensitivity: fails — harden tasks before acting on other arms"
+    return {"version": v, "h1_comps": h1_comps, "h1_reads": h1_reads, "h1_state": h1_state, "h1_line": h1_line,
+            "h1_ok": h1_state == "established", "a4": a4, "a4_read": a4_read, "a4_state": a4_state,
+            "a4_line": a4_line, "a4_ok": a4_state == "holds"}
+

+def budget_matched(an, v):
+    """The budget-matched baseline (Sprint 262 R3, informational, decides nothing): per review-catch task,
+    the union of a0_bare's valid trials' caught defects against a1_full's mean per-trial catch rate."""
+    out = {"suite_version": v, "available": False, "tasks": [], "a0_union_mean": None, "a1_mean": None,
+           "diff_mean": None, "note": None, "label": BUDGET_LABEL}
+
+    def valid(arm, task):
+        return [c["valid"] for _, c in sorted(an.cells.get((arm, task), {}).items()) if c["valid"] is not None]
+
+    tasks = sorted({t for (a, t) in an.cells if a in (BARE, CONTROL) and an.task_type.get(t) == REVIEW})
+    have = {a: any(valid(a, t) for t in tasks) for a in (BARE, CONTROL)}
+    if not (have[BARE] and have[CONTROL]):
+        missing = " and ".join(a for a in (BARE, CONTROL) if not have[a])
+        out["note"] = f"not available on suite_version {v} — no valid {missing} review-catch rows"
+        return out
+    out["available"] = True
+    for t in tasks:
+        a0, a1 = valid(BARE, t), valid(CONTROL, t)
+        e = {"task_id": t, "a0_trials": len(a0), "a1_trials": len(a1), "a0_union": None, "a0_cost_sum": None,
+             "a1_mean": None, "a1_cost_mean": None, "diff": None, "method": None, "reason": None}
+        if a0:
+            vecs = [an.defect_vector(r) for r in a0]
+            if all(vv is not None and how in ("ids", "cap") for vv, how in vecs):
+                e["a0_union"] = mean([max(vv[k] for vv, _ in vecs) for k in range(len(vecs[0][0]))])
+                e["method"] = "defect union"
+            else:
+                e["a0_union"] = max(an.catch_task_score(r) for r in a0)
+                e["method"] = "rate fallback"
+            e["a0_cost_sum"] = sum(float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in a0)
+        if a1:
+            e["a1_mean"] = mean([an.catch_task_score(r) for r in a1])
+            e["a1_cost_mean"] = mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in a1])
+        if a0 and a1:
+            e["diff"] = e["a1_mean"] - e["a0_union"]
+        else:
+            e["reason"] = "; ".join(f"no valid {a} trial" for a, rs in ((BARE, a0), (CONTROL, a1)) if not rs)
+        out["tasks"].append(e)
+    both = [e for e in out["tasks"] if e["diff"] is not None]
+    if not both:
+        out["available"] = False
+        out["note"] = f"not available on suite_version {v} — no review-catch task has valid trials in both arms"
+        return out
+    out["a0_union_mean"] = mean([e["a0_union"] for e in both])
+    out["a1_mean"] = mean([e["a1_mean"] for e in both])
+    out["diff_mean"] = out["a1_mean"] - out["a0_union_mean"]
+    k = sorted({e["a0_trials"] for e in both})
+    kk = str(k[0]) if len(k) == 1 else "the"
+    x = mean([e["a0_cost_sum"] for e in both])
+    y = mean([e["a1_cost_mean"] for e in both])
+    out["a0_cost_sum_mean"], out["a1_cost_mean"] = x, y
+    out["note"] = (f"{kk} a0_bare trials cost USD {x:.2f} vs one a1_full trial USD {y:.2f} "
+                   f"(task means over {len(both)} task{'' if len(both) == 1 else 's'})")
+    return out
+

+def batch_record(mans, rows):
+    """Each batch's STATUS.json (beside its MANIFEST.json, read-only) and the grader versions of its rows'
+    run directories (Sprint 262 R3); a missing file or directory is reported, never fatal."""
+    out = []
+    for b, m in sorted(mans.items()):
+        d = os.path.dirname(m["_path"])
+        brows = [r for r in rows if r["batch"] == b]
+        vks = sorted({k for k in (version_key(r.get("suite_version")) for r in brows) if k is not None},
+                     key=version_order)
+        sv = version_key(m.get("suite_version")) or (", ".join(vks) if vks else "n/a")
+        e = {"batch": b, "suite_version": sv, "smoke": m.get("smoke") is True, "status_file": None,
+             "status_note": None, "state": None, "trials_planned": None, "trials_rowed": len(brows),
+             "spend": None, "extra_models": {}, "rerowed": 0, "rerowed_tally": {}, "rerun": 0,
+             "rerun_tally": {}, "drift_cleared": 0, "outage_history": 0, "cuts": [], "paused_arms": [],
+             "grader_versions": {}, "run_dirs_missing": 0}
+        sp = os.path.join(d, "STATUS.json")
+        st = None
+        if os.path.islink(sp):
+            e["status_note"] = "STATUS.json is a symlink (not read)"
+        elif not os.path.isfile(sp):
+            e["status_note"] = "no STATUS.json"
+        else:
+            try:
+                with open(sp, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                    st = json.load(fh)
+            except (OSError, ValueError):
+                st = None
+            if not isinstance(st, dict):
+                st, e["status_note"] = None, "STATUS.json unreadable"
+        if st is not None:
+            e["status_file"] = sp
+
+            def lst(k):
+                x = st.get(k)
+                return x if isinstance(x, list) else []
+
+            def tally(k):
+                t = {}
+                for x in lst(k):
+                    if isinstance(x, dict):
+                        key = f"{x.get('from', '?')}→{x.get('to', '?')}"
+                        t[key] = t.get(key, 0) + 1
+                return dict(sorted(t.items()))
+
+            sd = st.get("spend") if isinstance(st.get("spend"), dict) else {}
+            e.update(state=st.get("state"), trials_planned=st.get("trials_planned"),
+                     spend={k: sd.get(k) for k in ("rows_usd", "ledger_usd", "spent_usd", "max_usd")},
+                     rerowed=len(lst("rerowed")), rerowed_tally=tally("rerowed"),
+                     rerun=len(lst("rerun")), rerun_tally=tally("rerun"),
+                     drift_cleared=len(lst("drift_cleared")), outage_history=len(lst("outage_history")),
+                     cuts=[{k: c.get(k) for k in ("reason", "at_trial", "spent", "max") if k in c}
+                           for c in lst("cuts") if isinstance(c, dict)])
+            em = st.get("extra_models")
+            if isinstance(em, dict):
+                e["extra_models"] = {str(k): {"runs": (x or {}).get("runs"), "output_tokens": (x or {}).get("output_tokens")}
+                                     for k, x in sorted(em.items()) if isinstance(x, dict) or x is None}
+            pa = st.get("paused_arms")
+            e["paused_arms"] = sorted(str(x) for x in (pa if isinstance(pa, (dict, list)) else []))
+        # grader versions: <batch dir>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/grade.json
+        listing = {}
+        gv = {}
+        for r in brows:
+            ad = os.path.join(d, r["arm"])
+            if ad not in listing:
+                try:
+                    listing[ad] = sorted(x for x in os.listdir(ad) if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(ad, x))
+                                         and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(ad, x))) \
+                        if os.path.isdir(ad) and not os.path.islink(ad) else []
+                except OSError:
+                    listing[ad] = []
+            dirs = []
+            for x in listing[ad]:
+                mm = GRADE_DIR.fullmatch(x)
+                if mm and mm.group(1) == r["task_id"] and int(mm.group(2)) == r["trial"]:
+                    dirs.append(x)
+            if not dirs:
+                e["run_dirs_missing"] += 1
+            for x in dirs:
+                gp = os.path.join(ad, x, "grade.json")
+                ver = "n/a"
+                if os.path.isfile(gp) and not os.path.islink(gp):
+                    try:
+                        with open(gp, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                            g = json.load(fh)
+                        if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("grader_version") not in (None, ""):
+                            ver = str(g["grader_version"])
+                    except (OSError, ValueError):
+                        pass
+                gv[ver] = gv.get(ver, 0) + 1
+        e["grader_versions"] = dict(sorted(gv.items(), key=lambda kv: (
+            kv[0] == "n/a", [int(p) if p.isdigit() else p for p in re.split(r"[.]", kv[0])])))
+        out.append(e)
+    return out

+def analyse(suite, vrows, mans, args, cuts, components, v):
+    """Every figure of one suite_version (the rows of no other version enter)."""
+    seed = args.seed
+    main = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False)
+    sens = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True)
+    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
+    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]
+
+    H = h1a4(main, v, seed)
+    h1_state, a4_state = H["h1_state"], H["a4_state"]
+    sens_h = h1a4(Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, include_degraded=True), v, seed)
+    decidable = any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or h1_state in H1_DECIDED or a4_state in A4_DECIDED
+    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
+            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
+    batches = sorted({r["batch"] for r in vrows})
+    shas = sorted({str(mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for b in batches
+                   if b in mans and mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")}
+                  | {str(r.get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for r in vrows if r.get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")})
+    return dict(H, rows=vrows, main=main, sens=sens, decisions=decisions, sens_rows=sens_rows,
+                decidable=decidable, caps=caps, batches=batches, shas=shas, sens_h=sens_h,

#               a6 ±0.25 alternating, d 0 (Simplify by the predicates, MDE > 0.10 →

#               rc-01 caught d1..d4 of 8 (a1 catches every defect): the defect unit weighs

def row(batch, arm, task, ttype, trial, status="completed", rate=None, catch=None, seeded=None,

        "flags": 3 if rc else None, "false_positives": 1 if rc else None,
        "verdict": "CHANGES_REQUIRED" if rc else "APPROVED", "verdict_accuracy": True,
        "verdict_accuracy_review": True, "verdict_accuracy_audit": True,
        "regressions": None if rc else 0, "diff_lines": None if rc else 100, "files_changed": None if rc else 2,
        "cost_usd": cost, "wall_clock_ms": wall, "tokens_in": 1000, "tokens_out": 100, "stalls": 0,
        "attempts": 1, "retry_reason": None, "degraded": degraded, "degraded_reason": degraded_reason,
        "status": status, "cap_phase": "IMPLEMENT" if status == "cap_failure" else None,
        "snapshots": {"implement": None, "fix1": None, "fix2": None}, "contaminated": None,
        "zone_violations": {"dot_claude_writes": [], "bash_mount_refs": [], "mount_changed": [],
                            "envelope_mismatch": []},
    }
    if rc and with_missed and missed is not None:
        r["defects_missed"] = missed
    return r


def rc_row(batch, arm, task, n, trial, missed, ids=True, **kw):

    def decide(self, arm, comps, c, w, share):
        T = float(self.rules.get("threshold_points", 0.03))
        C = float(self.rules.get("cost_lower_pct", 15))
        P = [p for p in comps if usable(p)]
        nopair = len(P) < len(comps)
        name = lambda p: p["metric"]  # noqa: E731
        if share is not None and r9(share) > self.guard:
            # DEC-0393: the degradation guard reads first, whatever the interval (lead's ruling, Sprint 260)
            clause = f"excluded share {share:.3f} > {self.guard:g}"
            return "inconclusive", f"inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): {clause}", [clause]
        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["lo"]) > 0]
        if hits:
            return "investigate", f"investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T and r9(p["hi"]) < 0]
        if hits:
            return "keep", f"keep: any applicable primary has d < -{T:g} and hi < 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
        clauses = []
        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T]
        if hits:
            clauses.append(f"d < -{T:g} ({', '.join(hits)})")
        if nopair:
            clauses.append("no valid pair (" + ", ".join(
                name(p) + (": degenerate" if p["n"] > 0 else "") for p in comps if not usable(p)) + ")")
        if clauses:
            return "inconclusive", "inconclusive: " + "; ".join(clauses), clauses
        cost_ok = (c is not None and r9(c) <= -C) or (w is not None and r9(w) <= -C)
        if all(r9(p["d"]) >= -T for p in comps) and cost_ok:
            which = []
            if c is not None and r9(c) <= -C:
                which.append(f"c = {c:+.1f}")
            if w is not None and r9(w) <= -C:
                which.append(f"w = {w:+.1f}")
            return "remove", (f"remove: every applicable primary has d >= -{T:g} and "
                              f"(c <= -{C:g} or w <= -{C:g}) ({', '.join(which)})"), []
        return "simplify", f"simplify: every applicable primary within -{T:g}, cost similar", []

    def arm_report(self, arm, cuts, seed):
        prims = self.primaries(arm)
        comps = [self.compare(arm, CONTROL, m, seed) for m in prims]
        c, w, n_cost = self.deltas(comps)
        share, ex, seen = self.excluded_share(arm)
        out = {"arm": arm, "arm_label": self.arms[arm].get("label", arm), "primaries": prims,
               "comparisons": comps, "c": c, "w": w, "cost_tasks": n_cost,
               "excluded_share": share, "excluded_cells": ex, "cells_seen": seen}
        if not seen:
            state, rule, clauses = "no_rows", "no rows for this arm", []
        else:
            state, rule, clauses = self.decide(arm, comps, c, w, share)
        out["predicate_state"] = state
        out["predicate_rule"] = rule
        label = DISPLAY.get(state, state)
        if state == "inconclusive" and any(cl.startswith("excluded share") for cl in clauses):
            label = "Inconclusive-by-degradation"
        out["predicate_label"] = label
        figure = None
        mde_cut = self.rules.get("mde_cut")
        over = [p for p in comps if p["mde"] is not None and mde_cut is not None and r9(p["mde"]) > float(mde_cut)]
        if arm in cuts:
            cut = cuts[arm]
            state, label = cut["state"], DISPLAY[cut["state"]]
            rule = f"{cut['source']}: {cut['reason']}".rstrip(": ")
            figure = cut["figure"]
        elif state in ("remove", "simplify") and over:
            figure = "; ".join(f"MDE {p['mde']:.3f} > {float(mde_cut):g} on {p['metric']} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
                               for p in over)
            rule = f"inconclusive_by_power: {figure} (predicate read {DISPLAY[out['predicate_state']]})"
            state, label = "inconclusive_by_power", DISPLAY["inconclusive_by_power"]
        out.update(state=state, label=label, rule=rule, figure=figure,
                   mde_flag=[p["metric"] for p in over])
        out["decidable"] = bool(seen) and all(usable(p) for p in comps)
        return out
