@test "AR-23 two suite_versions are never pooled: main sections on v2 (catch-rate H1, pass rate and A4 not testable), v1 in its own section; --suite-version 1 flips the primary" {
  J="$FX/versions/report.json"; M="$FX/versions/report.md"
  [ "$(jq -r .primary_suite_version "$J")" = "2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version | keys | join(",")' "$J")" = "1,2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$J")" = "H1: established" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "hidden_test_pass_rate") | .read' "$J")" = "not_testable" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "defect_catch_rate") | .d' "$J")" = "0.444444" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .a4.line "$J")" = "A4 sensitivity: not testable on suite_version 2 — no admissible build task" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .a4.state "$J")" = "not_testable" ]
  # the same task ids and trials in both versions: no duplicate-cell collision, no pooled rows
  [ "$(jq '.exclusions | length' "$J")" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .arms.a1_full.rows "$J")" -eq 12 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].arms.a1_full.rows' "$J")" -eq 48 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].h1.line' "$J")" = "H1: established" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].a4.line' "$J")" = "A4 sensitivity: holds" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["2"].h1.line' "$J")" = "$(jq -r .h1.line "$J")" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].decisions | length' "$J")" -eq 6 ]
  grep -qF 'hidden_test_pass_rate: not testable on suite_version 2 — no admissible task' "$M"
  grep -qxF '## Suite version 1 (batches: ver-v1) — reported separately, never pooled' "$M"
  grep -qF -- '  - suite_version 2 (primary: the main sections): 24 rows; batches ver-v2; suite manifest sha256 ddd200b3' "$M"
  grep -qF -- '  - suite_version 1 (reported separately, never pooled): 132 rows; batches ver-v1; suite manifest sha256 30e1f2ad' "$M"
  ! grep -qF 'DRIFT' "$M" || false
  # the v1 section carries its own H1 and A4 lines after the main sections
  awk '/^## Suite version 1 /{f=1} f' "$M" | grep -qF '**H1: established** — a1_full − a0_bare: hidden_test_pass_rate +0.200 [+0.200, +0.200] (n = 12 tasks)'
  awk '/^## Suite version 1 /{f=1} f' "$M" | grep -qF '**A4 sensitivity: holds**'
  report versions "$T/v1" --suite-version 1
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .primary_suite_version "$T/v1.json")" = "1" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .a4.line "$T/v1.json")" = "A4 sensitivity: holds" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .arms.a1_full.rows "$T/v1.json")" -eq 48 ]
  grep -qxF '## Suite version 2 (batches: ver-v2) — reported separately, never pooled' "$T/v1.md"
  report versions "$T/v3" --suite-version 3
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"--suite-version 3: no row has that suite_version (present: 1, 2)"* ]]
}

@test "AR-24 a row without suite_version among two versions stops the report (exit 2); a single-version input without the field works as before" {
  jq -c 'if .run_id == "ver-v2-a1_full-rc-01-t1" then del(.suite_version) else . end' "$FX/versions/runs.jsonl" > "$T/miss.jsonl"
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$T/miss.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/versions/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" --out "$T/miss.md"
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"row ver-v2-a1_full-rc-01-t1 has no suite_version while the rows hold suite_version 1, 2"* ]]
  [ ! -e "$T/miss.md" ]
  jq -c 'del(.suite_version)' "$FX/main/runs.jsonl" > "$T/one.jsonl"
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$T/one.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/main/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" --out "$T/one.md" --json "$T/one.json"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$T/one.json")" = "H1: established" ]
  [ "$(jq -c '[.decisions[] | .state]' "$T/one.json")" = "$(jq -c '[.decisions[] | .state]' "$FX/main/report.json")" ]
}

@test "AR-25 --partial with no pair reads 'not yet decidable (no pair)', exits 1 and prints no halt phrase (bd-wqbz3)" {
  report partial "$T/p" --partial
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$T/p.json")" = "H1: not yet decidable (no pair)" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.state "$T/p.json")" = "not_yet_decidable" ]
  ! grep -qF 'halt before promotion**' "$T/p.md" || false
  ! grep -qF 'harden tasks before acting on other arms**' "$T/p.md" || false
  # a4 rows without a1 rows: the A4 line has a task but no pair
  cp -R "$FX/partial" "$T/pa"
  jq -c '.arm = "a4_no_gates" | .run_id = (.run_id | sub("a0_bare"; "a4_no_gates"))' "$FX/partial/runs.jsonl" >> "$T/pa/runs.jsonl"
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$T/pa/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$T/pa/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" --out "$T/pa.md" --json "$T/pa.json" --partial
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .a4.line "$T/pa.json")" = "A4 sensitivity: not yet decidable (no pair)" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$T/pa.json")" = "H1: not yet decidable (no pair)" ]
}

@test "AR-26 the degradation guard governs H1: 9 of 12 a1 review rows degraded read inconclusive by degradation; --exclude-degraded false lets the same rows establish H1" {
  J="$FX/degraded/report.json"
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$J")" = "H1: inconclusive by degradation — not established" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.established "$J")" = "false" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "defect_catch_rate") | .read' "$J")" = "inconclusive_by_degradation" ]
  grep -qF 'defect_catch_rate inconclusive by degradation (a1_full excluded share 0.750 > 0.25)' "$FX/degraded/report.md"
  ! grep -qF '**H1: established**' "$FX/degraded/report.md" || false
  report degraded "$T/nd" --exclude-degraded false
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$T/nd.json")" = "H1: established" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "defect_catch_rate") | .read' "$T/nd.json")" = "tested" ]
}

@test "AR-28 a single-task rate-fallback catch pair is degenerate: flagged, and read as no valid pair by H1 and by the component decision" {
  J="$FX/degenerate-1/report.json"
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "defect_catch_rate") | .degenerate' "$J")" = "true" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "defect_catch_rate") | .lo > 0' "$J")" = "true" ]
  [[ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "defect_catch_rate") | .degenerate_reason' "$J")" == "valid pairs on one task (rc-04) with no per-defect ids"* ]]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$J")" = "H1: not yet decidable (no pair)" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of degenerate-1 a3_one_voice defect_catch_rate .degenerate)" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec degenerate-1 a3_one_voice .rule)" = "inconclusive: no valid pair (hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate: degenerate)" ]
  [ "$(dec degenerate-1 a3_one_voice .decidable)" = "false" ]
  grep -qF 'defect_catch_rate +0.500 [+0.500, +0.500] (degenerate) (n = 4 defects) — read as no valid pair' "$FX/degenerate-1/report.md"
  grep -qF '  - degenerate (read as no valid pair): valid pairs on one task (rc-04)' "$FX/degenerate-1/report.md"
}

@test "AR-34 budget-matched baseline: the a0 union beats every single a0 trial; rate fallback without ids; a version without review rows reads not available" {
  J="$FX/present/report.json"; M="$FX/present/report.md"
  t() { jq -r --arg t "$1" ".budget_matched.tasks[] | select(.task_id == \$t) | $2" "$J"; }
  [ "$(jq -r .budget_matched.suite_version "$J")" = "2" ]
  [ "$(t rc-01 '"\(.a0_union) \(.a0_cost_sum) \(.a1_mean) \(.a1_cost_mean) \(.diff) \(.method)"')" = "1.0 3.0 0.875 10.0 -0.125 defect union" ]

  [ "$(jq -r '[.[] | select(.arm == "a0_bare" and .task_id == "rc-01") | .defect_catch_rate] | max' <(jq -s . "$FX/present/runs.jsonl"))" = "0.5" ]

  [ "$(t rc-02 .a0_union)" = "0.5" ]

  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].budget_matched.available' "$J")" = "false" ]
  awk '/^## Suite version 1 /{f=1} f' "$M" | grep -qF -- '- not available on suite_version 1 — no valid a0_bare and a1_full review-catch rows'

@test "AR-23 two suite_versions are never pooled: main sections on v2 (catch-rate H1, pass rate and A4 not testable), v1 in its own section; --suite-version 1 flips the primary" {
  J="$FX/versions/report.json"; M="$FX/versions/report.md"
  [ "$(jq -r .primary_suite_version "$J")" = "2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version | keys | join(",")' "$J")" = "1,2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .h1.line "$J")" = "H1: established" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.h1.comparisons[] | select(.metric == "hidden_test_pass_rate") | .read' "$J")" = "not_testable" ]

  # the same task ids and trials in both versions: no duplicate-cell collision, no pooled rows
  [ "$(jq '.exclusions | length' "$J")" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .arms.a1_full.rows "$J")" -eq 12 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].arms.a1_full.rows' "$J")" -eq 48 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].h1.line' "$J")" = "H1: established" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].a4.line' "$J")" = "A4 sensitivity: holds" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["2"].h1.line' "$J")" = "$(jq -r .h1.line "$J")" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.by_suite_version["1"].decisions | length' "$J")" -eq 6 ]
  grep -qF 'hidden_test_pass_rate: not testable on suite_version 2 — no admissible task' "$M"
  grep -qxF '## Suite version 1 (batches: ver-v1) — reported separately, never pooled' "$M"
  grep -qF -- '  - suite_version 2 (primary: the main sections): 24 rows; batches ver-v2; suite manifest sha256 ddd200b3' "$M"
  grep -qF -- '  - suite_version 1 (reported separately, never pooled): 132 rows; batches ver-v1; suite manifest sha256 30e1f2ad' "$M"
  ! grep -qF 'DRIFT' "$M" || false
  # the v1 section carries its own H1 and A4 lines after the main sections
  awk '/^## Suite version 1 /{f=1} f' "$M" | grep -qF '**H1: established** — a1_full − a0_bare: hidden_test_pass_rate +0.200 [+0.200, +0.200] (n = 12 tasks)'
  awk '/^## Suite version 1 /{f=1} f' "$M" | grep -qF '**A4 sensitivity: holds**'
  report versions "$T/v1" --suite-version 1
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r .primary_suite_version "$T/v1.json")" = "1" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .a4.line "$T/v1.json")" = "A4 sensitivity: holds" ]
  [ "$(jq -r .arms.a1_full.rows "$T/v1.json")" -eq 48 ]
  grep -qxF '## Suite version 2 (batches: ver-v2) — reported separately, never pooled' "$T/v1.md"
  report versions "$T/v3" --suite-version 3
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"--suite-version 3: no row has that suite_version (present: 1, 2)"* ]]
}

head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1082 — The batch-record grader_version sort key builds a list that mixes ints and strings (`[int(p) if p.isdigit() else p ...]`). Two grade.json versions such as "1.2.13" and "1.2.13-rc1" (or "1.2.12" and "dev") then compare int to str and raise TypeError. Nothing catches it (main() handles only Fail), so the whole report run dies with a traceback and exit 1, which is also the documented "--partial, nothing decidable" code. A free-form field in a run directory's grade.json can block report generation. Use a total-order key, e.g. tuples tagged (0, int) / (1, str).
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:906 — H1 reads "not established — halt before promotion" as soon as any one primary is `tested` with lo <= 0, even if another primary is inconclusive_by_degradation, degenerate or no_pair. The new degradation guard can therefore turn an H1 the catch rate would have established into a halt verdict, when it should read inconclusive. In the same way, a pass-rate pair alone can trigger the halt while the catch rate has no pair yet. "Not established" should require every non-not_testable primary to be tested; otherwise the line should read inconclusive by degradation or not yet decidable.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1192 — `decidable` now counts h1_state "not_established" as decided whatever the other primaries' read is. In base, `all(p["n"] > 0 for p in h1_comps)` was required. So under --partial, a run whose review-catch rows have not arrived yet (catch rate no_pair) and whose pass-rate interval straddles 0 exits 0 with a halt line, instead of exit 1 (no decision final). This is a regression in the --partial contract. AR-30 only covers the case where the other primary is not_testable.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:634 — The degenerate test uses `n_tasks == 1`, where n_tasks counts every pair, including pairs that contribute no defect diffs (a task without defects_seeded gives defect_vector None, so `pair["defects"] = 0`). If two catch-rate pairs exist but only one task contributes diffs, and that task falls back to the rate, the interval is still zero-variance by construction but is not flagged. H1 and the component decision then treat it as a real interval. Count the pairs with `defects > 0` instead.
head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:410 — defects_missed accepts any list of non-empty strings, but its only consumer, ablation-report.py defect_vector (head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:551), only recognises the ids `d1`..`dN`. An id in another form ("D2", "defect-2") or beyond defects_seeded is silently read as caught. The per-defect vector then disagrees with the row's defect_catch_rate, and the H1/component catch-rate intervals and the budget-matched union are computed from wrong vectors. Nothing checks that len(missed) == defects_seeded − defects_caught. The row writer (or --validate) should enforce the `^d[1-9][0-9]*$` grammar and the count consistency, or at least refuse the mismatch.
head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:165 — --validate checks only the types of defects_missed. It accepts a non-null defects_missed on a build row and ids that contradict defects_seeded/defects_caught, so the "list of dK ids" contract that the report relies on is never enforced at the validation gate (see the previous finding).
head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:414 — The header (lines 57-60) documents regressions_final_green as null on review-catch rows, but unlike defects_missed (gated on task type at line 410) it is not gated on task type: a review-catch grade.json with `regressions.final_green` produces true/false on a review-catch row. Gate it on the build task types like defects_missed, or correct the documentation.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:831 — version_key maps a non-integer numeric suite_version (e.g. 2.1, which the row validator accepts as a number) to None, i.e. "absent". Among two versions, the report then aborts with a misleading "has no suite_version" error. With one other version, the row is silently pooled into that version, which is exactly what the partition promises never to do. Non-integer floats should keep their own key (e.g. repr) or be refused explicitly.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1065 — The grader-version tally counts every directory that matches the row's (task, trial), including superseded `-r<k>` reruns and the original attempt. When a batch holds more than one row for a cell (a re-rowed or rerun cell), each row counts the same directories again. The tally is inflated and does not describe the grade.json actually behind the rows.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1191 — The sensitivity H1/A4 Analysis uses cap_excluded=True, so cap failures become excluded cells and feed the H1/A4 degradation guard (assess → excluded_share). The "sensitivity (decides nothing)" lines can therefore read "inconclusive by degradation" because of cap failures rather than degraded rows, which contradicts the stated treatment "cap failures excluded, degraded rows included".
head/evals/tests/ablation-report.bats:512 — AR-35 is titled "the presentation items change no decision, H1/A4 state or existing number", but it only asserts that the new keys exist plus two spot values. It never compares decisions, h1/a4 or the existing figures against a run without the presentation code (or against the base outputs), so the claim it names is untested.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:174 — The PR is titled and described as the ablation-row.sh 1.2 field change, but most of the diff is ablation-report.py 1.0.0 → 1.2.0: suite_version partitioning, new H1/A4 states, the degenerate rule, batch record, precision and budget-matched baseline. These change how H1 and the component decisions are reached, and the commit list in PR.md names sprint-261 credential and grader fixes that are not in this diff. The decision-affecting report change should be described, or split out, so that it gets its own review.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

content.text:
I've written the review to `/workspace/review.md`: 12 findings, and the verdict is **CHANGES_REQUIRED**.

**Testing caveat:** I couldn't run either test suite. The suite file `evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml` and the run fixtures `evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/` aren't in `pr/`. The machine's jq 1.6 also can't compile the row writer's existing jq program (`label` is a reserved word in 1.6), and that problem predates this PR. To exercise the two new fields I ran a copy in `/tmp` with that one shorthand rewritten. The extraction and `--validate` behaved as documented, except for the review-catch gap noted below. I reproduced the crash below directly.

**What blocks the merge:**
- **The report can crash on a grade file's contents** (`ablation-report.py:1082`). The new batch record sorts grader versions with a key that mixes numbers and text. Two versions like "1.2.13" and "1.2.13-rc1" raise a TypeError that nothing catches, so the whole report dies with exit 1. That is also the code that means "`--partial`, nothing decided yet".
- **H1 can say "halt" too early** (`:906`). The halt line ("not established — halt before promotion") appears as soon as one primary metric is tested and doesn't clear zero. That holds even when the other metric was set aside by the new degradation guard, is degenerate, or has no pair yet. A result the catch rate would have established can turn into a halt instead of "inconclusive".
- **`--partial` exits 0 when it should exit 1** (`:1192`). In the same situation, a partial run now counts as decided. Before, every H1 metric needed a valid pair.

**Other findings:**
- **Defect ids aren't checked** (`ablation-row.sh:410`, `:165`). The row writer and `--validate` accept any non-empty strings in `defects_missed`. The report only understands `d1`…`dN` and treats anything else as caught. Nothing checks the list against `defects_seeded` minus `defects_caught`.
- **`regressions_final_green` isn't limited to build rows** (`ablation-row.sh:414`). The header says it is null on review-catch rows, but the code doesn't check the task type the way `defects_missed` does.
- **The degenerate rule can miss a case** (`ablation-report.py:634`). It counts every paired task, including tasks that contribute nothing to the catch-rate figure. A zero-variance single-task result can slip through unflagged.
- **Non-integer suite versions are mishandled** (`:831`). A version like 2.1 is treated as missing, so the report either aborts with a misleading message or pools the row into another version.
- **The grader-version tally over-counts** (`:1065`) superseded reruns and duplicate rows.
- **The sensitivity H1/A4 lines** (`:1191`) can read "inconclusive by degradation" because of cap failures, which contradicts their stated treatment.
- **Test AR-35 doesn't test what its name claims** (`ablation-report.bats:512`): it never compares decisions or numbers against a baseline.
- **The PR is mostly something else:** it's described as the row writer change, but most of the diff is the report's 1.0.0 → 1.2.0 rewrite, which changes how decisions are reached.
